text: MLS Terminal 是面向 DeepSeek Harness TUI 的终端外观插件，提供酸雨黄配色和全屏开场动画。它通过 TUI 主题与场景接口注册两套配色，在启动时可自动选用主题并播放动画，也支持快捷键重播。用户可以暂停或提前退出开场，并调整动画强度、图形模式和字符格比例。适合希望个性化终端界面、同时保留宿主对话与会话功能的 dsh-TUI 用户；需要已有 dsh-TUI 环境，不需额外 API 密钥。

MLS Terminal adds an Acid Rain theme and animated opening to DeepSeek Harness TUI. It supports startup playback, replay, pause and early exit, with configurable motion and terminal graphics. Requires dsh-TUI; no extra API key is needed.
想给 DeepSeek Harness 的终端界面换一套深色荧光主题
让 dsh-TUI 启动时展示全屏开场动画
有没有可以用酸雨黄配色美化终端的插件
我想用快捷键重新播放 TUI 的开场画面
I want a custom color theme and animated startup for my terminal assistant.
Can I replay a full-screen intro in the DeepSeek Harness TUI?
希望更改终端鲸鱼主题，同时保留原来的会话界面
I need a terminal theme that can adapt its opening animation to different window sizes.
MLS Terminal 的功能「双配色主题」：插件注册 MLS Acid Rain 与 256 色两套 TUI 配色，并可在激活时自动选择主主题。
MLS Terminal 的功能「启动开场动画」：插件场景在启动时绘制全屏终端开场，动画结束后关闭场景并返回宿主界面。
MLS Terminal 的功能「重播与动画控制」：用户可用 Alt+M 重播开场，在动画中暂停或通过 Esc、Enter、q、点击及其他按键退出。
MLS Terminal 的功能「终端尺寸与图形适配」：动画按视口尺寸和字符格比例生成原生字符画；可选择自动加载中心 logo 图像。

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · dsh-tui-marathon：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A Marathon-inspired appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness TUI. Version 0.4.3 provides an Acid Rain theme and a responsive full-screen opening through the stock TUI's public interfaces. Conversations, models, tools and storage remain with Harness / dsh-TUI.

**Inspired by the repo [ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop](https://github.com/ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop)**

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · dsh-tui-marathon：Version 0.4.3: actual 120×36 terminal output, replayed as a 24 fps GIF (about 10.3 seconds). The logo stays visible through the blue hold and maze transition until the red sweep covers it. The native interface returns after the opening.

The repository is named `dsh-tui-marathon`; the installable Cordis package is `dsh-theme-mls-tui`.

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Install, then run dsh-tui：This assumes `dsh`, `dsh-tui` and pnpm are already installed and your existing `dsh-tui` starts successfully. Supported host: dsh-TUI 0.14.x; verified version: 0.14.0.

Install the theme once:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz
```

Keep using your usual command afterward:

```sh
dsh-tui
```

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Install, then run dsh-tui：The plugin joins the launcher's default `dsh-tui` profile, selects Acid Rain and plays the opening automatically. No source checkout, host build or project-directory launch is needed. If you set `DSH_HOME`, use the same value during installation and startup. Restart `dsh-tui` after configuration changes or updates.

First-time host users can complete its normal credential setup after the opening. The theme does not change model, credential or session configuration.

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Install, then run dsh-tui：Alternatively, download [the v0.4.3 archive](https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz) and replace the URL above with its local file path.

To remove the theme and keep using `dsh-tui`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-theme-mls-tui
```

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Appearance and compatibility：- Automatic animation runs only at startup. Successful turns, cancellations and history replay never open an animation.
- Acid Rain yellow `#D7FF00`, dark surfaces and neutral body text. The opening retains electric blue, maze graphics and the red panel exit.
- Actual terminal text, block glyphs, borders and solid color cells replace the old full-frame sampled renderer.
- Six green scan frames use heavy box-drawing strokes and closer spacing; the scan stage lasts 0.8 seconds longer than 0.4.2.
- Both whale axes share one physical scale. Borders, maze and panels fill the viewport independently, including host page margins.
- The host frame clock drives motion without the former 50ms quantization. Measured moving-frame output is approximately 58 fps; terminal and machine load affect results.
- Resizing works during playback and pause. Validation covers 48–180 columns, 20–54 rows and several physical cell proportions.

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Appearance and compatibility：The stock pixel whale has hardcoded blue pixels. The plugin hides it through public `setWhale(false)`, keeps the themed native title and restores the previous preference on unload. Set `nativeWhale: true` to retain that sprite.

Stock `tuiScenes` replaces the conversation. Panel masks animate within the plugin scene; the original conversation returns on close. Progressive reveal of native content needs an additional host interface. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md).

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Controls and configuration：`Alt+M` replays the opening. During animation, `Esc`, `Enter`, `q` or click exits; space pauses/resumes. Configure Option as Alt/Meta on macOS when needed.

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Controls and configuration：| Cordis option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoTheme` | `true` | Select and save MLS once on activation |
| `autoBoot` | `true` | Play the startup opening |
| `motion` | `full` | `reduced`: brief static display; `off`: theme only |
| `graphics` | `cells` | `auto`: use a supported host image only for the central logo; outer geometry stays native |
| `cellAspect` | `0` | Read host cell measurements; fall back to height / width = 2 |
| `nativeWhale` | `false` | Keep the unthemeable stock blue whale |

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Controls and configuration：No terminal brand is required. If the host supplies no pixel metrics, arbitrary font proportions cannot be inferred exactly. Optional `cellAspect` calibration uses cell height / width, such as `1.8` or `2.2`. Native cell rendering needs no image protocol.

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Development：These steps are for source changes; theme installation does not require them. Source development uses Node `^22.19 || >=24` and pnpm `11.21.0`. Keep a stock `dsh-TUI/` checkout next to this repository for dev links and integration tests. The revision below is the verified host baseline:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.git
git -C dsh-TUI checkout 1d832df3f97e828b1aaea8376657d6b6ecf30b86
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI build

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Development：For interactive development, `npm run setup:local` installs the official Harness CLI into ignored `.runtime/`; then run `npm start`. That launcher uses isolated development configuration and sessions. Normal use follows the `dsh-tui` workflow above. Configure API credentials through your shell environment as required by Harness. Do not commit credentials or sessions. Model-free tests need no API key.

Environment variables for the development launcher:

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · Development：```sh
MLS_GRAPHICS=auto npm start
MLS_CELL_ASPECT=2.2 npm start
MLS_NATIVE_WHALE=1 npm start
MLS_MOTION=reduced npm start

Optional development commands:

```sh
npm run measure:motion
npm run pack:local
```

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · dsh-tui-marathon：[English](README.md)

受《马拉松》视觉风格启发的 DeepSeek Harness TUI 外观插件。0.4.3 通过原版 TUI 的公开接口提供酸雨黄主题与全屏开场。宿主源码、对话、模型、工具和会话存储均由现有 Harness / dsh-TUI 管理。

收到GitHub仓库[ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop](https://github.com/ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop)的启发

0.4.3 版实际 120×36 终端输出，以 24 帧/秒 GIF 回放，约 10.3 秒。Logo 在蓝色停留和迷宫过渡期间保持显示，直到红扫将其覆盖；开场结束后返回原生界面。

GitHub 仓库名为 `dsh-tui-marathon`，可安装的 Cordis 包名仍为 `dsh-theme-mls-tui`。

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 安装后直接运行 dsh-tui：默认你已经安装 `dsh`、`dsh-tui` 和 pnpm，且原来的 `dsh-tui` 能正常启动。当前支持 dsh-TUI 0.14.x，已验证版本为 0.14.0。

只需安装一次主题：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz
```

以后仍然使用原来的命令：

```sh
dsh-tui
```

插件加入启动器默认使用的 `dsh-tui` profile，自动启用酸雨黄主题并播放开场。无需克隆源码、编译宿主或进入本项目目录。`DSH_HOME` 如有设置，安装与启动时使用相同的值。修改插件配置或更新后重启 `dsh-tui` 生效。

首次使用宿主时，开场结束后仍可按原有引导配置 API 凭据。主题不修改模型、凭据或会话配置。

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 安装后直接运行 dsh-tui：也可以手动下载 [v0.4.3 安装包](https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz)，将上面命令中的 URL 换为下载文件路径。

卸载主题后，继续使用原来的 `dsh-tui`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-theme-mls-tui
```

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 效果与适配：- 仅进入时自动播放开场；任务完成、取消和历史回放均不打开动画。
- 主色为酸雨黄 `#D7FF00`，搭配深黑底、灰白正文；开场保留电蓝、迷宫与红色分块退出。
- 默认使用实际终端文字、块字符、边框和实心色块，移除旧版整帧点阵渲染。
- 六层绿色扫描框使用加粗线形字符，间距适度收紧；扫描阶段比 0.4.2 延长 0.8 秒。
- 鲸鱼两个方向共用同一物理缩放比例；边框、迷宫和扫块分别按窗口宽高铺满，包括宿主页边距。
- 通过宿主时钟更新，取消旧版 50ms 帧量化。测试中的运动段输出约 58 帧/秒，实际表现取决于终端和负载。
- 窗口调整在播放、暂停时均生效。已覆盖 48–180 列、20–54 行以及不同字符格比例。

宿主原生像素鲸鱼使用写死的蓝色，公开主题接口不能重新着色。插件默认通过公开的 `setWhale(false)` 隐藏它，保留酸雨黄原生标题；卸载时恢复原值。设 `nativeWhale: true` 可保留原生鲸鱼。
dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 效果与适配：原版 `tuiScenes` 替换对话视图。红扫在插件场景内分块退出，结束后返回原生界面；逐块揭露原生对话仍受接口限制。详见 [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md)。

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 控制与配置：`Alt+M` 重播开场。动画中 `Esc` / `Enter` / `q` / 点击退出；空格暂停或继续。macOS 可将 Option 配成终端的 Alt/Meta。

| Cordis 配置 | 默认 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoTheme` | `true` | 激活时选中并保存 MLS 主题 |
| `autoBoot` | `true` | 启动时播放开场 |
| `motion` | `full` | `reduced` 静态短展示；`off` 仅应用主题 |
| `graphics` | `cells` | `auto` 在支持时只用宿主图片绘制中心鲸鱼；外围始终是字符 |
| `cellAspect` | `0` | 自动读取宿主字符格尺寸；缺失时使用高宽比 2 |
| `nativeWhale` | `false` | 是否保留无法换色的原生蓝色鲸鱼 |
dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 控制与配置：不依赖某个终端品牌。宿主未提供字符格像素尺寸时，无法精确推断所有字体的高宽比；可将 `cellAspect` 校准为字符格高度 / 宽度，例如 `1.8`、`2.2`。默认字符渲染不要求图片协议。

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 开发：以下仅供修改源码使用；安装主题无需这些步骤。源码开发使用 Node `^22.19 || >=24` 与 pnpm `11.21.0`。通过 dev links 使用相邻的原版 `dsh-TUI/`，集成测试也使用该目录。以下固定宿主版本已通过验证：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.git
git -C dsh-TUI checkout 1d832df3f97e828b1aaea8376657d6b6ecf30b86
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI build

dsh-theme-mls-tui README · 开发：交互开发前执行 `npm run setup:local`，将官方 Harness CLI 安装到忽略的 `.runtime/`；随后运行 `npm start`。此入口使用隔离的开发 profile 与会话；正式使用走上方的 `dsh-tui`。按 Harness 要求通过 shell 环境提供 API 凭据，勿提交密钥或会话。模型无关测试无需 API key。

开发入口专用环境变量：

```sh
MLS_GRAPHICS=auto npm start
MLS_CELL_ASPECT=2.2 npm start
MLS_NATIVE_WHALE=1 npm start
MLS_MOTION=reduced npm start

可选开发命令：

```sh
npm run measure:motion
npm run pack:local
```

遵循 MIT 许可证，保留第三方素材署名。测试边界见 [QUALITY.md](QUALITY.md)，素材来源与生成方式见 [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md)。
